actions.script: const out = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.commons.CalendarServices.get#CalendarSetup').call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {calendarList: out.calendarList, defaultCalendarId: out.defaultCalendarId, defaults: out.defaults, timeZone: out.timeZone, todayText: out.todayText, nowText: out.nowText, me: out.me, roomOptions: out.roomOptions, failedSources: out.failedSources})

const out = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.commons.CalendarServices.get#CalendarEvents').parameters({start: start, end: end, calendarIds: calendarIds || '', hiddenCalendarIds: hiddenCalendarIds || '', showDeclined: showDeclined === 'Y' || showDeclined === 'true', showTasks: showTasks === 'Y' || showTasks === 'true'}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {eventList: out.eventList, skippedCalendarIdList: out.skippedCalendarIdList, failedSources: out.failedSources})

const out = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.commons.CalendarServices.search#CalendarEvents').parameters({text: text || '', calendarIds: calendarIds || ''}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {resultList: out.resultList})

const out = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.commons.CalendarServices.create#QuickEvent').parameters({workEffortName: workEffortName || '', start: start || '', end: end || null, allDay: allDay || 'N', calendarId: calendarId || null, facilityId: facilityId || null, attendeePartyIds: attendeePartyIds || null, repeat: repeat || null, reminderMinutes: reminderMinutes ?? null, location: location || null, description: description || null}).call() // More options (andOpen Y): the new event's screen opens ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : Object.assign({workEffortId: out.workEffortId, url: out.url, messageInfos: [{type: 'success', message: out.message, link: out.url, linkText: ec.l10n.localize('Open')}].concat((out.warningList || []).map((text) => ({type: 'warning', message: text})))}, andOpen === 'Y' && out.url ? {screenUrl: out.url} : {}))

const id = workEffortId || '' ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.commons.CalendarServices.get#EventAccessInfo').parameters({workEffortId: id, need: 'edit'}).call() if (ec.message.hasError()) { ec.web.sendJsonResponse({}); return } const out = ec.service.sync().name('mantle.work.EventServices.cancel#EventOccurrence').parameters({workEffortId: id, instanceStart: instanceStart || null, scope: scope || 'all', notify: notify || 'N', eventUrl: '/qapps/Commons/Calendar/EventDetail?workEffortId=' + encodeURIComponent(id)}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {messageInfos: [{type: 'success', message: out.message}]})

ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.commons.CalendarServices.save#CalendarRailState').parameters({hiddenCalendarIds: hiddenCalendarIds ?? null, showTasks: showTasks ?? null, showDeclined: showDeclined ?? null}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse({})

render-mode.text: ${JSON.stringify([{t: "dynamicContainer", id: "CalendarTui", url: sri.buildUrl("../CalendarTui").addParameters({date: date || null, showTasks: showTasks || null}).getUrlWithParams()}])}
The Calendar is a .qvue screen: open it under /qapps.
